text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
O-Ohhh... This power...
It's definitely no coincidence...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I am on the verge of awakening as the "End-of-Century Overlord."Are you saying... Doto surpasses me
before my awakening...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Phew... haah... S-somehow...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O was caught off guard
and suffered a defeat to Meisho Doto.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“It's more than just a matter of victory or defeat,
however. It means Meisho Doto has gained strength
rivaling that of T.M. Opera O.”

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Very well, Doto. With this curtain fall,
it is about time we define our true form.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I ask thee, Meisho Doto!
Just what manner of being art thou!?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Will you become my lifelong nemesis, to perform
in a battle of gods—Ragnarok—of which none know the end, or not!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Uuu, I... I...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san's...
lifelong rival...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: A　B　S　O　L　U　T　E　L　Y　N　O　T　! ! ! ! !

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Words filled with so many heartfelt emotions
echoed throughout autumn at Fuchu.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Running today... made me realize.
As I thought, Opera O-san isn't my enemy at all.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
She's my idol, my goal,
and the person I've been chasing after all this timeeee!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
It's because Opera O-san was there
that I became this strong...
And I can keep becoming even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
It's not about being enemies, but something much warmer.
It's not like I want us to hurt each other.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
That's why... I want to be your "rival"!
Not an enemy, but your "lifelong rival"!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
To be rivals who run together forever,
trading wins and losses!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Because I think... that brings the greatest happiness.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Happiest of all...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I see... Doto...
So that is the answer you've found.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Very well. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O took Meisho Doto
in front of the grandstand—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hear me, fans filling this arena!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, this Meisho Doto is the rival
who will continue running closest to me!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Please watch over this fierce yet beautiful bond
we share as we battle, our hearts connected as one.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "And I promise you! Now that I've found a worthy rival and gained even more momentum—"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The year-end Arima Kinen!
She will show everyone she can truly surpass the Golden Generation!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Is this alright?
My dear friend, Doto.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! Um... Opera O-san!
Good luck in the Arima Kinen~!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, I'll do my best. As the king of our generation,
and for Doto and Ayabe-san's sakes, too."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, their story reached a happy ending,
competing against each other while still holding hands.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet the true decisive battle is still to come. At the
Arima Kinen, the strongest generation awaits the supreme king.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, let's go.
To the final grand stage.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
With Doto not running, I am likely the only one from our generation
who can battle the heroes of the past era.
However—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
There is nothing to fear.
As long as you remain by my side, that is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: We exchange a firm, determined glance. T.M. Opera O turns toward the packed grandstand, and—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
My friends, I am T.M. Opera O!
And today, by uniting with my fellow generation—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Together, they all became
the 'T.M. Opera O Party'!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
As you all know,
the Umamusume competing in the Arima Kinen are decided by fan vote.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
For me to advance in the top spot, I require
everyone's support. And therefore——!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone gathered here today!
Please cast your pure and honest vote for the TM Opera Party!
I beg of you, give me your vooooote!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
TM Opera O begged for votes.
Carried away by the momentum, she somehow started speaking in polite keigo...
